subject: Renewal procurement: phased PO plan & onboarding evidence
messages:
From: Maggie Lowe <maggie@heliotech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliotech.com
Date: 2029-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity bump — procurement process and evidence handoff

Jonas,

Thanks for the call this morning. We confirmed internally that HelioTech wants to move forward on a 24-month renewal with an immediate +30% capacity uplift for Q1 (usage-based). Finance prefers to issue two POs rather than a single large commitment: one covering Jan–Jun and the other Jul–Dec.

Before we can route this through our procurement portal we need: a) updated SOC2 attestation for 2029, b) a short onboarding checklist for our procurement intake (so our ops team can validate technical controls), and c) an example PO split template your side suggests.

Can you share the SOC2 attestation and a proposed PO split by end of day Monday? Procurement is looped above; Samir (Finance) will sign once they see the split and contract language on term.

Thanks,
Maggie Lowe
Procurement Lead
HelioTech Labs

Attachment: none (referenced below)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maggie Lowe <maggie@heliotech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2029-12-01T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump — procurement process and evidence handoff

Maggie — thanks, we'll action. Quick plan:

- SOC2: attaching the 2029 attestation PDF (SOC2-Redwood-2029.pdf).
- PO split: attached a PO-split-template.xlsx with two line items and suggested billing schedule.
- Onboarding checklist: onboarding-checklist-v2.docx covers the procurement intake fields you typically ask for (contact, IP allowlist, KMS details, retention policy, required evidence).

Internal next steps: @Marissa will prepare the formal proposal with updated term language (24 months + capacity uplift clause). @Karthik and @Olga — please confirm that the onboarding checklist maps to our Private deployment intake (VPC/KMS options).

I'll follow up tomorrow with the proposal PDF and a short note for Samir to speed approval.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-Redwood-2029.pdf; PO-split-template.xlsx; onboarding-checklist-v2.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: procurement@heliotech.com, Maggie Lowe <maggie@heliotech.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2029-12-02T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump — procurement process and evidence handoff

Hi Maggie,

Thanks for the clear ask — looping in procurement ops notes below and a suggested cadence to keep approvals moving: 

1) Day 0 (today): HelioTech confirms PO split preference (we can accept two POs as proposed).
2) Day 1: Redwood to deliver proposal + redlineable contract showing the 24-month term and a capacity uplift clause (done — draft attached).
3) Day 2–3: Procurement uploads first PO in portal; HelioTech Ops validates checklist fields.
4) Day 4: Once PO validated, Redwood provisioning team stages capacity change for Jan 1 start. Second PO to be uploaded by June 15 to cover Jul–Dec.

Notes on approvals: If Finance needs a single signer affidavit or payment term changes (Net30 -> Net45), flag that now so we can generate SOW amendment language.

Attaching: redlineable-proposal-HT-8421.pdf (proposal with the term/uptick clause). Happy to hop on a 15-minute call this afternoon with Samir if that will speed sign-off.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlineable-proposal-HT-8421.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliotech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, procurement@heliotech.com
Date: 2029-12-03T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump — procurement process and evidence handoff

Marissa / Jonas — thanks for the speedy turnaround. A few quick items from Finance: 

- The PO split template looks fine but we need a short line in the PO that references the Redwood SLA exception clause for capacity surges. Can you add a 1-line SLA reference?
- Payment terms: we can do Net45 on the first PO; second PO needs to include a conditional yes (we'll confirm in June).
- For audit: please confirm the SOC2 PDF contains complimentary subservice organization attestations (or provide contact to request them).

If you can update the PO template and confirm SOC2 subservice notes, I can route the first PO through our portal today. I'm happy to join a 15-min sync at 11:30 PST.

Samir Patel
Finance — HelioTech Labs
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliotech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Maggie Lowe <maggie@heliotech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2029-12-04T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump — procurement process and evidence handoff

Samir — appreciate the clear asks. Quick status update and deliverables attached: 

- Updated PO-split-template.xlsx: added SLA reference line ("Redwood Inference: Capacity surge SLA Appendix A, see contract section 5.3").
- SOC2-Redwood-2029.pdf: includes index pointing to subservice attestations; if you need the vendor letters we'll pull and share a redacted bundle (we can provide within 24 hours on request).
- Proposal (redlineable-proposal-HT-8421.pdf) updated to include Net45 for PO1 and a placeholder for PO2 conditional terms.
- Onboarding checklist verified for Private deployments (Karthik confirmed VPC/KMS fields; Olga confirmed evidence fields).

Next steps: Samir to upload PO1 to HelioTech portal today; Redwood will queue capacity staging for Jan 1. I'll send a short confirmation email once the portal shows the PO in 'validated' status. If there's anything else required for audit, call out specifics and we'll assemble the bundle.

Thanks everyone — excited to keep HelioTech scaled for Q1.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference
